Bill.BriefDescription: Establishing the voting age for school board elections.

BillBody.BillTitle: AN ACT Relating to the voting age for school board elections; andamending RCW 28A.320.400.
BillBody.EnactingClause: BE IT ENACTED BY THE LEGISLATURE OF THE STATE OF WASHINGTON:

BegSecAmd.BegSecText: RCW 28A.320.400 and 1969 ex.s. c 223 s 28A.58.520 are eachamended to read as follows:

BillSection.RCWSLText: Qualifications of electors above the age of eighteen at all schoolelections shall be the same as at a general state or county election.Except as otherwise provided by law, only those electors residingwithin the district shall be entitled to vote((, and)). Studentshaving attained the age of fourteen as of the date of the electionshall be entitled to vote in school board elections for the district inwhich they are enrolled and in good standing. An elector may vote onlyat the polling place designated by the proper election official.
